entities.summary: Gustavus Adolphus's military revolution, the Swedish intervention in the Thirty Years' War (1630), the victory at Breitenfeld (1631), Gustavus's death at Lützen (1632), and the Peace of Westphalia granting Sweden territories in northern Germany.
